metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1993 · Farewell My Concubine
metas.description: Two boys meet at an opera training school in Peking in 1924. Their resulting friendship will span nearly 70 years and endure some of the most troublesome times in China's history.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1998 · The Legend of 1900
metas.description: A baby boy discovered on an ocean liner in 1900 grows into a musical prodigy, never setting foot on land.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1993 · Three Colors: Blue
metas.description: A woman struggles to find a way to live her life after the death of her husband and child.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1996 · Shine
metas.description: David Helfgott, a gifted pianist, struggles through childhood as his dysfunctional father abuses him and his siblings. Years later, he suffers a mental breakdown but manages to return as a legend.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1991 · The Double Life of Véronique
metas.description: Two parallel stories about two identical women; one living in Poland, the other in France. They don't know each other, but their lives are nevertheless profoundly connected.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1991 · The Commitments
metas.description: Jimmy Rabbitte, an unemployed Dublin boy, decides to put together a soul band made up entirely of the Irish working class.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1998 · The Red Violin
metas.description: A red-colored violin inspires passion, making its way through three centuries over several owners and countries, eventually ending up at an auction where it may find a new owner.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1993 · The Piano
metas.description: In the mid-19th century a mute woman is sent to New Zealand along with her young daughter and prized piano for an arranged marriage to a farmer, but is soon lusted after by a farm worker.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1994 · The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
metas.description: Two drag performers and a transgender woman travel across the desert to perform their unique style of cabaret.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1995 · Mr. Holland's Opus
metas.description: A frustrated composer finds fulfillment as a high school music teacher.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1994 · Immortal Beloved
metas.description: A biopic exploring Beethoven's tumultuous life, focusing on his romantic pursuits. The film investigates the identity of the mysterious woman to whom the composer penned a passionate love letter, delving into his complex relations...

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1993 · What's Love Got to Do with It
metas.description: The story of singer Tina Turner's rise to stardom and how she gained the courage to break free from her abusive husband, Ike Turner.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1998 · SLC Punk!
metas.description: In the early 1980s, Stevo and Heroin Bob are the only two dedicated punks in conservative Salt Lake City.
